title: Deliver one activity: code, commit, evidence, closure
description: Use when implementing, fixing or closing one LPM activity (atividade/issue): commit with the LPM-Activity trailer, comment progress, attach evidence (prints, logs, tests). Old name: software-project-orchestrator. Not for planning many activities (use lpm-plan-work) or AISH jobs (use lpm-aish-jobs).
doneWhen: The activity's code is committed with the trailer, progress is commented, evidence is attached and listed, and the activity is done, or stays in-progress with one named pending item and its owner.
authorityCeiling: Reads, comments, evidence and status moves are [A]; editing or removing a comment and removing evidence are [C]; done only through playbook close.
jobs: fix bug ISSUE-ID and commit with the LPM-Activity trailer
pick the next activity and do it
registre o progresso na atividade com os testes
attach the test report to the activity
posso fechar esta atividade? conclua com evidência
remove the wrong screenshot from the activity
comenta na atividade que os testes passaram
apaga o comentário duplicado na atividade

notFor.when: creating or reorganizing many activities, owners, dates or cycles
a blocked activity, a blocker context or a dependency
work that must run on AISH runners
AISH delivery artifacts or a failing factory DoD audit
evidence from WhatsApp or an intake protocol
a question about what the code does, with no activity to deliver

sharedRefs.name: repo-hygiene
sharedRefs.loadWhen: background on code work in a git repository; the playbooks already hold its steps

references.loadWhen: playbook start: start or continue work on one activity
playbook commit-and-progress: commit with the LPM-Activity trailer, or comment progress
playbook evidence: attach a screenshot, log or test report
playbook close: close the activity, or answer "can I close it?"
playbook fix-comment-or-attachment: edit or remove a comment, or remove an attachment
playbook connector-only: attach or close on a ChatGPT/Claude connector

codex.shortDescription: Ship one LPM activity with commit trailer and evidence
